flyspace.source.failed.decision: Count failures of the keyless sources the server relays, by provider and reason, so a dead source is seen before a canvas block goes empty.

flyspace.registry_intent.failed.decision: Record that JEV search routing failed and why; search already falls back to keyword results, so this is a warning and never carries the query.

flyspace.llm.failed.decision: Record a failed provider call by provider, HTTP status and error class; the scrubbed error text stays in the ledger row, never in the log.

flyspace.ledger.query_failed.decision: Record a failed ledger read, runs or lineage, without the pg error, which can carry the connection string.

flyspace.ledger.open_failed.decision: Record that a run row could not open and the ledger paused for 30 s; only the error class is kept, since its text can carry the connection string.

flyspace.ledger.close_failed.decision: Record that a run row stayed 'running' because its closing write failed, so the stuck row has a cause in the log.

flyspace.ledger.reconcile_failed.decision: Record that marking stale hosted runs 'uncertain' failed, so rows left 'running' have a cause in the log.

flyspace.auth.unavailable.decision: Record that the identity provider timed out or is misconfigured, the one authentication failure that is ours to fix rather than the caller's.

flyspace.db.idle_client_failed.decision: Record an idle Postgres client error by class only, so a dropped connection is visible without its text and never takes the process down.
